title: Concept: SHA-1 use via sha1.convert (dart) — review required
description: In dart, sha1.convert computes SHA-1. Public collision demonstrations ended SHA-1's suitability for signatures and integrity, though content addressing and legacy interop remain legitimate. The dart-specific remedy is sha256.convert.
applicability: dart codebases hashing data through sha1.convert; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged signatures and integrity values where SHA-1 guards trust; LOW default severity, raised when the digest is security-relevant.
